description: Use for «how much is an H100 / RTX 4090 per hour», «cheapest GPU cloud». Every GPU card model in the catalog (H100, A100, L40S, L4, RTX 4090, RTX 5090, A6000…) with the number of plans and hosts, the cheapest plan and its approximate price per hour (by default only plans billed by the hour) and per month, and the card's page. For the full list of one card use search_vps with gpu_card.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of server locations (any of them).

hourly.description: Only plans billed by the hour (false = monthly plans too).

locale.description: Language of names and page links; also the price currency: ru = RUB, en = USD, de/es/pt = EUR, tr = TRY.

name: gpu_prices
title: GPU server prices per hour
